population: 2340 frozen main SID; accepted historical first-departure model input2231; joint measured preRH/preShear/PI(t0)1256; no future-completeness entry gate
latitude: absolute latitude only within separate hemisphere; 3-term restricted cubic basis; training-fold knots at .05,.35,.65,.95

support.environment: both local neighborhoods 3D convex hull of measured complete environment rows
support.bootstrap_support: fixed empirical support target; no outcome-driven retuning

environment_timing.past_RH: mean of at least3 valid -24,-18,-12,-6h observations
environment_timing.PI_t0_ms: saved t0_PIheadroom + current wind_kt*1852/3600; not a pret0 mean

state_threshold_gap: Vref_kt minus wind_t0_kt; Vref from history strictly preceding t0, never future LMI
outcome_model: accepted v62 eight-bin6h interval-logistic hazard with original L_h/U_h

crossfit.membership: original saved SID fold; copies keep fold

bootstrap.paired_across: both models, both latitude targets, environment-difference change
bootstrap.refit: preprocessing and outcome model in every fold/draw

reference: actual entire observed covariate rows of supported same-hemisphere basins, equal SID weights; bootstrap empirical reweighting; same rows M0/M1
contrast: higher abs latitude minus lower abs latitude; probability percentage points
environment_change: M0 contrast minus M1 contrast, paired draws; no explained percentage
sensitivity: one linear-latitude functional-form sensitivity on same support; no threshold/year/environment search
